generalCriterionList.description: Tenders  from Joint ventures are not acceptable.

Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for
 corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka
Bidders shall ensure upload of relevant document certifying his/her status as Scheduled Caste/ Scheduled Tribe/other reserved category as prescribed in the tender document.

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.

technicalCriterionList.description: Reports on the financial standing of the tenderer, such as profit and loss statements and auditor’s reports for the last five years
Qualification and experience of the key technical and management personnel in permanent employment with the tenderer and those that are proposed to be deployed on this contract, if awarded
List of Financial Resources with Certificates
Prescribed EMD shall be submitted through KPP Portal.
Chartered Accountant (CA) Certificate for the Turnover for Last 3 Financial Years with UDIN should be enclosed

technicalCriterionList.description: Tender Declaration form is to be uploaded in the Technical Bid. (As mentioned in Annexure -2)
Details of tenderers Bio-data should be enclosed
Satisfactorily completed as prime contractor, at least Similar parlour works such as Milk Parlour works of value not less than Rs. 50.00 Lakhs.

The tenderer should be a manufacturer/supplier of milk parlor structures as specified in the notification. The bidder should supplied and installed milk parlor structures in any of the last four years as on the date of bid opening. The bidder should have executed similar structures minimum of 5 Nos of Milk Parlour structure in any of the co-operative dairies in India / KMF / Milk Unions.
Site Visit Certificate issued by the Managing Director, SHIMUL should be uploaded in the Technical Bid. (As mentioned in Annexure -1)
GST Registration Certificate shall be attached
PAN Registration Certificate should be enclosed.
IT Returns & P&L and Balance Sheet duly signed certified by Chartered Accountant for the Last 3 Financial Years should be enclosed.
Achieved in at least one financial years a minimum financial turnover of Rs. 1.50 Crores per year in the last Three financial years.
